tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
XikeStor 12-Port 10G SFP+ L3 Web Managed Ethernet Network Switch (SKS8300-12X V2.0) Update Hardware


The XikeStor SKS8300-12X is a high-performance 12-Port 10G SFP+ Layer-3 Web Managed Network Switch, designed for enterprise networks, data centers, ISPs, and high-speed backbone infrastructure. With advanced Layer-3 routing, powerful switching capacity, and flexible web-based management, this switch ensures reliable, scalable, and ultra-fast network performance.


Key Features


  • 12 × 10G SFP+ Ports for ultra-high-speed fiber connectivity
  • Update Hardware
  • Layer-3 (L3) Managed Switch with static routing support
  • Web GUI + CLI Management for easy configuration and monitoring
  • Advanced VLAN, QoS, ACL & LACP Support
  • High Switching Capacity for non-blocking data transmission
  • Enterprise-Grade Metal Rackmount Design
  • Energy-Efficient & Stable Performance
